blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense supervision directly on student-generated trajectories, making it an effective post-training strategy for vision-language models in temporal video grounding (TVG). However, existing pipelines typically construct the training curriculum from a fixed teacher and the initial student state, implicitly assuming that selected examples retain positive supervision value throughout optimization. We show that supervision trustworthiness and supervision necessity are distinct yet coupled: the former concerns target credibility, while the latter varies with the student’s current task competence; together, they shape supervision value. Building on this coupled view, we introduce Student–Curriculum Coupling (SCC) , a closed-loop framework in which a compact Anchor–Frontier curriculum defines the candidate supervision space and the evolving student dynamically determines its active subset. Supervision can therefore be activated, suspended, or reactivated as competence changes, concentrating teacher computation and optimization on current task-level deficits. Across three TVG benchmarks, SCC achieves a 5.1% relative improvement in mean recall over Video-OPD on its original curriculum, while using 60.0% fewer training examples and reducing training time by 50.4%. Ablations support the complementary roles of capability-structured curriculum design and student-dependent supervision in achieving these gains. Together, these results establish SCC as a data- and compute-efficient framework for TVG post-training, delivering stronger temporal grounding by aligning trustworthy supervision with the student’s evolving learning needs.
blocks.zh: 政策上分馏(OPD)直接对学生生成的轨迹进行密集的监督,使其成为时间视频地平面(TVG)中视觉语言模型的有效培训后战略. 然而,现有管道通常从固定教师和初始学生状态中构建培训课程,隐含地假设选定的实例在整个优化过程中保持了积极的监督价值。 我们显示,监督的可信度和监督的必要性是截然不同的,但却是相辅相成的:前者涉及目标可信度,而后者则与学生目前的任务能力不同;两者共同决定了监督的价值。 基于这种结合的观点,我们引入了学生-Curriculum Coupling(SCC),这是一个封闭式框架,其中紧凑的Anchor-Frontier课程定义了候选监督空间,而不断发展的学生动态地决定其活动子集。 因此,随着能力的变化,可以启动、中止或恢复监督,将教师的计算和优化集中在目前的任务一级缺陷上。 在三个TVG基准中,SCC在最初课程中比Video-OPD的平均召回率提高了5.1%,同时使用的培训实例减少了60.0%,培训时间减少了50.4%。 拨款支持能力结构课程设计和依靠学生的监督在实现这些成果方面的互补作用。 这些结果共同将SCC确立为TVG后培训的数据和计算效率框架,通过将可信赖的监管与学生不断演变的学习需要相配合,提供更强大的时间基础。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Temporal video grounding (TVG) localizes the segment in an untrimmed video that corresponds to a natural-language query ( Gao et al., 2017 ) . As vision-language models (VLMs) have become increasingly capable of jointly reasoning over video and language, recent work has cast TVG as generative temporal prediction, with target intervals produced directly as timestamps ( Huang et al., 2024a ; Wang et al., 2025 ) . However, precise localization, particularly at event boundaries, remains challenging, motivating task-specific post-training ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . Among these approaches, on-policy distillation (OPD) trains the student on its own generated trajectories using dense token-level teacher feedback ( Lu and Thinking Machines Lab, 2025 ; Agarwal et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2026c ) . Video-OPD applies this paradigm to TVG ( Li et al., 2026a ) . Beyond the distillation objective itself, the effectiveness of OPD for TVG also depends on how teacher supervision is allocated across training examples, highlighting the importance of curriculum design and adaptive data selection ( Bengio et al., 2009 ; Chen et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: Timoral video grounding (TVG) 将片段本地化为一款与自然语言查询相对应(Gao等, 2017. 随着视觉-语言模型(VLMs)越来越有能力对视频和语言进行联合推理,最近的工作将TVG设定为分基因时间预测,目标间隔作为时间戳直接产生(Huang等人,2024a; 王等, 2025 (中文(简体) ). 然而,精确的本地化,特别是在事件边界上,仍然具有挑战性,激发了针对特定任务的培训(Wang等人,2026年)。 在这些方法中,政策分解(OPD)利用密集的符号级教师反馈对学生进行自身产生的轨迹培训(Lu and Thinking Machines Lab,2025;Agarwal等,2024;Li等,2026c.). Video-OPD将这一范式应用于TVG(Li等,2026a.). 除了蒸馏目标本身之外,TVG的OPD的有效性还取决于教师监督如何在培训实例中分配,强调课程设计和适应性数据选择的重要性(Bengio等,2009;Chen等,2023)。

blocks.en: In OPD for TVG, curriculum construction can use teacher reliability and the performance gap between a fixed teacher and the initial student to select informative examples ( Li et al., 2026a ) . Selected examples typically receive supervision whenever presented, carrying an implicit persistent-value assumption that their supervision remains useful throughout optimization. As student competence evolves, however, initial suitability alone cannot determine whether supervision remains necessary. We therefore distinguish supervision trustworthiness , which concerns whether the teacher provides a credible target for an example, from supervision necessity , which concerns whether the current student still exhibits a task-level deficit on that example. Together, these factors motivate a coupled view in which curriculum composition and supervision realization are jointly designed to align trustworthy supervision with the student’s changing learning needs.
blocks.zh: 在TVG的OPD中,课程建设可以使用教师的可靠性和固定教师与初学者之间的成绩差距来选择信息化的例子(Li等,2026a.). 典型的情况是,所选实例一经介绍就受到监督,其中隐含着一种持续价值的假设,即其监督在整个优化过程中仍然有用。 然而,随着学生能力的发展,仅凭最初的适宜性无法确定监督是否仍然必要。 因此,我们把监督的可信度与监督的必要性区分开来,后者涉及教师是否为一个例子提供了可信的目标,而后者则涉及目前学生是否仍然在这种例子上表现出任务层次的不足。 这些因素加在一起,促使人们形成一种共同的观点,即课程组成和监督的实现是为了使可靠的监督与学生不断变化的学习需要相一致。

blocks.en: Building on this coupled view, we introduce Student–Curriculum Coupling (SCC) , a closed-loop OPD framework that jointly designs curriculum composition and supervision realization. SCC constructs a compact Anchor–Frontier (AF) curriculum around the initial student’s capability profile, preserving trustworthy supervision opportunities for capability acquisition and stabilization. These opportunities contribute to optimization only when the current student exhibits a task-level deficit, so that candidate-space composition and current student competence jointly determine active supervision. OPD updates in turn reshape the student’s supervision needs, which guide subsequent curriculum realization and close the feedback loop.
blocks.zh: 基于这种结合的观点,我们引入了学生-Curriculum Comupling(SCC),这是一个封闭式开放的OPD框架,共同设计课程组成和监督实现. SCC围绕学生初始能力概况构建了紧凑的Anchor-Frontier(AF)课程,为能力获取和稳定保留了可靠的监督机会。 这些机会只有在目前学生表现出任务层次的不足时,才有助于优化,这样,候选人-空间组成和目前学生的能力共同决定积极的监督。 OPD的更新反过来重塑了学生的监管需要,这指导了随后的课程实现并关闭了反馈回路.

blocks.en: We evaluate SCC on Charades-TimeLens ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , ActivityNet-TimeLens ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , and QVHighlights-TimeLens ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) . Compared with Video-OPD on its Teacher-Validated Disagreement Focusing (TVDF) curriculum ( Li et al., 2026a ) , SCC achieves a 5.1% relative improvement in mean recall across the three benchmarks and intersection-over-union (IoU) thresholds of 0.3 0.3 , 0.5 0.5 , and 0.7 0.7 . These gains are obtained with 60.0% fewer training examples and 50.4% shorter training time.

blocks.en: 3.1 On-Policy Distillation

On-policy distillation optimizes a student VLM π θ \pi_{\theta} using token-level supervision from a teacher VLM π T \pi_{T} whose parameters remain fixed. The student generates trajectories from its current policy, and the teacher supplies target next-token distributions at the corresponding prefixes ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2026a ) . Given a TVG input x = ( v , q ) x=(v,q) , the rollout policy π θ t \pi_{\theta_{t}} at training step t t generates an autoregressive trajectory of length L t L_{t} : y t = ( y t , 1 , … , y t , L t ) ∼ π θ t ( ⋅ ∣ x ) . y_{t}=(y_{t,1},\ldots,y_{t,L_{t}})\sim\pi_{\theta_{t}}(\cdot\mid x). At position k k , let h t , k = ( x , y t , < k ) h_{t,k}=(x,y_{t,<k}) denote the current prefix, and define the student and teacher next-token distributions as p θ , k ( ⋅ ) = π θ ( ⋅ ∣ h t , k ) p_{\theta,k}(\cdot)=\pi_{\theta}(\cdot\mid h_{t,k}) and p T , k ( ⋅ ) = π T ( ⋅ ∣ h t , k ) p_{T,k}(\cdot)=\pi_{T}(\cdot\mid h_{t,k}) , respectively.

blocks.en: We use Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct ( Bai et al., 2025a ) as the student. For direct comparison with Video-OPD ( Li et al., 2026a ) , we use its released Qwen3-VL-32B teacher, trained with group relative policy optimization (GRPO). We use a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 6 1\times 10^{-6} and a 79-step training schedule with variable scheduled global batch sizes capped at 32 (Appendix B.2 ). blocks.en: Figure 4 traces the coupled evolution of student competence and the effective curriculum, highlighting the complementary roles of Anchors and Frontiers during training. Anchor competence remains high in the early stage, and most Anchor presentations are suspended, limiting additional optimization in already-supported capability regions. When an Anchor falls below the task criterion, its supervision is reactivated, allowing Anchors to support capability stabilization. Frontiers, meanwhile, account for most active OPD routes, and their competence rises with overall student progress. The AF curriculum therefore combines stabilization of existing capabilities with acquisition along the learning frontier.

blocks.en: As more Frontier examples reach the criterion, cumulative acquisition rises to 46.9% of the 900 unique Frontier examples. Over the same period, the update rate declines, suspension becomes more prevalent, and effective-batch OPD loss decreases through the main acquisition phase. Later in training, OPD supervision becomes increasingly sparse, with occasional empty effective batches and updates concentrated on the remaining deficits. This progression reflects the closed loop underlying SCC, in which the current student shapes the effective curriculum, the resulting OPD updates alter the student, and the updated state governs supervision in subsequent batches.

blocks.en: 6 Related Work
blocks.zh: 6 相关工作

blocks.en: VLM-based TVG research has focused on both training strategies and temporal modeling. Training approaches range from boundary-aware instruction tuning and time-aware objectives ( Huang et al., 2024a ; Wang et al., 2024c ) to reinforcement-based post-training for temporal localization and spatiotemporal perception ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2025b ; Chen et al., 2025 ) . Complementary work makes temporal structure explicit through timestamp-aware visual encoding ( Ren et al., 2024 ) and dedicated temporal representations ( Huang et al., 2024b ; Wang et al., 2025 ) , with TRACE modeling events as sequences of timestamps, saliency scores, and captions ( Guo et al., 2025 ) . To handle longer videos, TimeSuite combines efficient token processing with grounded tuning ( Zeng et al., 2025 ) , while ReVisionLLM adopts recursive coarse-to-fine localization ( Hannan et al., 2025 ) . Alongside these modeling advances, TimeLens examines annotation quality and training strategies, providing curated training data and re-annotated benchmarks for more reliable evaluation ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 以VLM为基础的TVG研究侧重于培训战略和时间模型。 培训方法包括边界感知指示调整和时间感知目标(Huang等,2024a; Wang等,2024c.)到强化后训练,进行时间定位和瞬间感知(Wang等,2026;Li等,2025b;Chen等,2025.). 补充工作通过时间戳-意识视觉编码(Ren等,2024年)和专用时间表示(Huang等,2024b;Wang等,2025年)明确了时间结构,将TRACE模型事件作为时间戳的序列,显著分数和标题(Guo等,2025年). 为了处理较长的视频,TimeSuite将高效的符号处理与被锚定的调子(Zeng等人,2025年)结合起来,而ReVisionLLM则采用递归粗到细本地化(Hannan等人,2025年). 除了这些建模进展外,TimeLens还审查了说明质量和培训战略,提供了整理的培训数据和重新附加说明的基准,以便进行更可靠的评价(Zhang等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: OPD trains on student-generated sequences with teacher feedback at the same visited prefixes, reducing distribution mismatch between training and inference ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ; Lu and Thinking Machines Lab, 2025 ) . MiniLLM adopts reverse KL to avoid overestimating low-probability teacher outputs ( Gu et al., 2024 ) , while entropy-aware OPD supplements this objective with forward KL when teacher entropy is high to preserve generation diversity ( Jin et al., 2026 ) . Alongside objective design, OPD analyses examine how compatible reasoning patterns and teacher capabilities novel to the student affect knowledge transfer, linking successful distillation to progressive alignment on high-probability tokens ( Li et al., 2026c ) . Video-OPD extends this paradigm to TVG, providing dense token-level supervision by scoring student-generated trajectories without separate teacher rollouts ( Li et al., 2026a ) . Building on this formulation, our work identifies the implicit persistent-value assumption and develops a coupled view of OPD.
blocks.zh: OPD列车在学生生成的序列上使用老师在同一访问前缀的反馈,减少培训与推论之间的分布不匹配(Agarwal等,2024;Lu and Thinking Machines Lab,2025). 迷你LLM采用倒向KL来避免高估低概率的老师输出(Gu等,2024年),而当教师的Entropy-aware OPD高能保存生成多样性时用前向KL来补充这一目标(Jin等,2026年). 除了客观设计外,OPD分析还研究了与学生兼容的推理模式和师资能力新颖如何影响知识转让,将成功的分馏与高概率符号的渐进相接联系起来(Li等,2026c.). Video-OPD将这一范式延伸至TVG,通过不单独推出教师的评分学生生成的轨迹提供密集的符号级别监督(Li等,2026a.). 基于这一提法,我们的工作确定了隐含的持久性价值假设,并对业务发展办公室提出了综合观点。

blocks.en: Curriculum learning organizes training examples by difficulty or learning structure ( Bengio et al., 2009 ) , while classical self-paced learning adapts an easy-to-hard curriculum alongside model updates ( Kumar et al., 2010 ) . Online hard example mining and Selective-Backprop instead prioritize high-loss examples ( Shrivastava et al., 2016 ; Jiang et al., 2019 ) . For language models, DoReMi learns domain-mixture weights through proxy-model optimization ( Xie et al., 2023 ) , while RegMix predicts effective mixtures from smaller-scale experiments ( Liu et al., 2025 ) . Skill-It adapts sampling to skill dependencies and current learning progress ( Chen et al., 2023 ) . In TVG, curriculum design encompasses temporal-task complexity and difficulty-aware data construction for reinforcement post-training ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . Video-OPD combines teacher validation with teacher–student disagreement for candidate selection ( Li et al., 2026a ) . Compared with prior work on sample prioritization, SCC couples supervision trustworthiness with evolving student competence, jointly designing curriculum composition and supervision realization in OPD for VLM-based TVG.
blocks.zh: 课程学习通过难度或学习结构来组织培训实例(Bengio等,2009年),而古典自定进度的学习则在更新模式的同时,调整了易于硬化的课程(Kumar等,2010年)。 (Shrivastava等,2016;Jiang等,2019)。 对于语言模型,多雷米通过代理模型优化来学习域-混合权重(Xie等,2023年),而RegMix则通过更小规模的实验预测出有效的混合物(Liu等,2025年). 技能-它使抽样适应技能依赖性和目前的学习进展(Chen等,2023年)。 在TVG中,课程设计包含了时间任务的复杂性和难度意识数据构建,用于强化后培训(Wang等,2025;Chen等,2025;Wang等,2026). Video-OPD将教师验证和教师-学生在候选人选择上的分歧结合起来(Li等,2026a.). 与先前的样本优先排序工作相比,SCC夫妇对学生能力不断发展的可信赖性进行监督,共同为基于VLM的TVG设计课程组成和监督实现OPD.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: This work shows how supervision aligned with evolving task competence can improve both accuracy and efficiency in VLM post-training. Distinguishing supervision trustworthiness from necessity leads to a coupled view of OPD, linking curriculum composition to the student’s changing learning needs. SCC realizes this view through a compact AF-defined space of trustworthy supervision opportunities, with current student competence guiding their selective activation. Across three TVG benchmarks, it achieves higher grounding accuracy than Video-OPD on TVDF with fewer training examples, fewer teacher-scored trajectories, and shorter training time. Together with ablations and training-dynamics analyses, these results highlight the value of jointly designing curriculum composition and supervision timing.
blocks.zh: 这项工作表明,与不断演变的任务能力相配合的监督可如何提高自愿培训后的准确性和效率。 将监督的可信度与必要性区分开来会导致对业务发展办公室的结合观点,将课程组成与学生不断变化的学习需要联系起来。 SCC通过一个紧凑的AF定义的值得信赖的监督机会空间来意识到这一观点,目前学生的能力指导他们选择性地激活. 在TVG的三项基准中,它比Video-OPD在TVDF上的定位精确度更高,培训实例较少,教师分数轨迹较少,培训时间也较短。 这些成果连同编程和培训动态分析,突出了共同设计课程组成和监督时间安排的价值。

blocks.en: Despite these gains, SCC assesses supervision necessity using tIoU between a single sampled prediction and the ground-truth interval. This task-level proxy does not directly estimate the marginal effect of supervising an example on generalization, and routing decisions may be sensitive to sampling variability. Extending this annotation-dependent assessment to tasks without comparable ground truth also requires alternative signals. Beyond these assessment limitations, our evaluation focuses primarily on TVG post-training within one VLM family. Future work should develop more direct, less annotation-dependent estimates of supervision value and evaluate this coupled design across additional model families and tasks.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展,SCC仍利用一个抽样预测和地面-真实间隔之间的tIoU来评估监督的必要性。 这种任务级的代用不直接估计监督一个实例对通化的边际影响,而路由决定可能对采样可变性敏感. 将这种依赖注释的评估扩大到没有可比地面真相的任务也需要其他信号。 除了这些评估限制外,我们的评估主要侧重于一个VLM家庭内的TVG后培训。 今后的工作应当对监督价值作出更直接、更不依赖注释的估算,并在其他模范家庭和任务中评价这种组合设计。

blocks.en: Table 7 compares SCC with TimeLens-8B ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) and single-round Video-OPD ( Li et al., 2026a ) . blocks.en: B.8 Robustness to Teacher Choice

blocks.en: We assess robustness to teacher choice using Qwen3-VL-4B and Qwen3-VL-8B ( Bai et al., 2025a ) teachers trained with the same GRPO recipe on a separately constructed 2,500-example difficulty-weighted curriculum. Construction follows the Time-R1 and TimeLens procedures ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) adopted in Video-OPD ( Li et al., 2026a ) , but the selected example set differs from that used to train its released 32B teacher. Each teacher supervises a Qwen3-VL-8B student on the original AF candidate set without teacher-specific re-filtering, with all other student-training settings held constant. We reuse the 32B-qualified AF set without assuming that every example remains qualified under the 4B/8B teachers. Table 12 reports teacher and student performance across the three TVG benchmarks.

blocks.en: We compare the default single-rollout assessment with three- and five-rollout variants using mean tIoU against the ground-truth interval. blocks.en: Additional rollouts provide modest gains at some checkpoints, including slightly higher endpoint mIoU on ActivityNet-TimeLens, but yield no consistent advantage across benchmarks. Training time increases with the rollout count. These results support single-rollout assessment as a practical choice, maintaining comparable overall TVG performance with shorter training time under the evaluated settings.
